About Johnny O
Whether as a public school teacher or as Baltimore County Executive, John “Johnny O” Olszewski Jr. has dedicated his life to serving our community.
Johnny was born and raised right here in Baltimore County, and he’s a proud alum of our public schools. The first in his family to earn a college degree, Johnny started his career by serving his community teaching civics in Baltimore County Public Schools for seven years. When he saw firsthand the challenges that our students and community face, Johnny decided to run for public office.
As County Executive, Johnny O has led bold and transformative change for creating a better and more progressive Baltimore County. In his first year, Johnny passed legislation that prevents guns from falling into the hands of dangerous criminals by setting security standards for gun retailers. He closed an $81 million budget deficit all the while raising teacher pay and strengthening the County’s historic commitment to school construction.
Whether tackling issues like gun safety and police reform, instilling principles of equity and accountability back into our government, or securing record funding for our public schools, Johnny O has shown in Baltimore County what we can do when we come together for the greater good.
With democracy under attack and extremists threatening to take away our basic rights, it’s clear that the time is now for a new generation of leadership. As your Representative, Johnny O will protect reproductive rights and abortion access, defend our democracy and our vote, and fight to restore transparency and accountability in our government.

pages.title: Johnny O – Democrat for Congress | Johnny’s Priorities
pages.text:
## Defending Democracy
As a former public school civics teacher, Johnny knows how important and fragile our democracy truly is. Whether standing up to insurrectionists at the Capitol or to extremists taking away voting rights, Johnny will always fight back against those trying to undermine our democracy.
## Preserving the Environment
From combating climate change to cleaning up the Chesapeake Bay, protecting our environment is one of the most important issues that we face. Congress must act with urgency to address the climate crisis and invest in the green energy economy of the future.
Johnny will advocate for bold, science-based solutions to reduce carbon emissions, invest in renewable energy sources, and safeguard our natural landscapes. Together, we can build a sustainable future where clean air, clean water, and thriving ecosystems are accessible to all.
## Reproductive Freedom
Johnny understands that abortion access is health care, and he will always fight to ensure that women can make their own reproductive health decisions. Legislators should never stand between women and their healthcare, and Johnny will oppose any efforts from those seeking to ban access to abortion, birth control, or to prevent women from having the right to choose.
## Transparency and Accountability
As Baltimore County Executive, Johnny O has followed through on promises of reform, bringing government closer to the people it serves. Congress is broken, and it too often lets self-interest and special interests get in the way of progress. We need leaders like Johnny who will enact meaningful lobbying reforms and restore trust in our public institutions.
## Common Sense Gun Safety
Common sense gun safety measures are critical to protecting our communities and preventing senseless tragedies. Advocating for universal background checks, closing loopholes in the current system, and implementing red flag laws are essential steps in addressing the epidemic of gun violence. As your representative in Congress, Johnny will work tirelessly to enact common sense gun safety legislation, ensuring that every American can live without fear of gun violence in their neighborhoods and schools.
## Strengthening the Middle Class
Johnny understands that a thriving middle class is the backbone of our economy and the cornerstone of our democracy. As your representative in Congress, Johnny will fight to ensure that hardworking families have access to good-paying jobs, affordable healthcare, and quality education. By advocating for fair wages, expanding access to vocational training, and protecting workers’ rights, Johnny will work tirelessly to empower the middle class and build an economy that works for everyone.
## Technology and Innovation
Embracing emerging technologies like blockchain and cryptocurrency presents exciting opportunities for economic growth and financial inclusion. Johnny believes in harnessing the potential of these technologies while ensuring robust regulatory frameworks to protect consumers and safeguard against illicit activities.
Congress must act to update the status quo—securities legislation from 1933 is not capable of governing 21st century technologies. By fostering innovation responsibly, we can unleash the full potential of the digital economy and pave the way for a more prosperous and equitable future for all.
## Voting Rights
As a former public school civics teacher, Johnny knows both how important and how fragile our democracy truly is. As Baltimore County Executive, he passed historic campaign finance reform, protected our right to vote, and kept our elections secure.
When politicians put barriers between people and the ballot box, it’s an attack on our democracy and one of our most sacred rights. In Congress, Johnny will continue fighting for free and fair elections and working to protect every citizen’s fundamental right to vote.

pages.title: ACCOMPLISHMENTS – Baltimore County Executive Johnny Olszewski
pages.text:
## Open and Connected Government
Government works best when people drive the conversation. As Baltimore County Executive, Johnny O has followed through on promises of reform, bringing government closer to the people it serves and opening our government like never before.
## Better Schools in Every Community
As a former high school teacher in Baltimore County, education has and will always be Johnny O’s top priority. As County Executive, he has provided record funds for education, including significant funding to raise teacher pay and hire more educators, counselors, and pupil personnel workers.
## Combating COVID
During the COVID-19 pandemic, Johnny O has focused on the County’s priorities of protecting public health, supporting residents, and helping local businesses. In these past two years, we’ve seen incredible needs in our communities. As County Executive, Johnny O took unprecedented steps to support residents and businesses during the pandemic.
## Safe Neighborhoods
Keeping our communities safe is among the most important responsibilities of local government. Johnny O has taken a number of steps to make our county safer, by curbing crime, taking on the opioid epidemic, and ensuring equity in policing.
## A Sustainable Future
We have an obligation to protect our environment and leave behind a cleaner and greener county – and world – for future generations. Under Johnny O’s leadership, Baltimore County is a statewide leader on renewable energy and sustainability, leaving no stone unturned in our work to advance sustainability.
## Vibrant Communities
Baltimore County residents depend on local government to provide high quality services that keep our communities vibrant, safe, and clean. As County Executive, Johnny O has prioritized efforts to provide high quality government services, bolster our local economy, and strengthen our neighborhoods.

About Johnny O
Congressman Johnny “Johnny O” Olszewski, Jr. is a lifelong Marylander and proven leader who has proudly represented Maryland’s 2nd Congressional District since 2025. Guided by the working-class values he learned growing up in eastern Baltimore County, Johnny O is focused on the issues that matter most, like lowering costs for families, expanding economic opportunity, and protecting the foundations of American democracy.
Johnny O began his professional life as a public-school teacher, where he saw firsthand the challenges facing students and families. That experience shaped his service in the Maryland House of Delegates, where for more than nine years he fought for stronger schools, fair wages, and equal rights. As the youngest lawmaker ever to chair Baltimore County’s House delegation, he helped pass landmark progress — including earned sick leave, and an increase to the minimum wage. Olszewski was also a deciding vote for marriage equality.
As Baltimore County Executive, Johnny O brought transformative, transparent leadership to Maryland’s third-largest jurisdiction. In managing a $5 billion budget and a workforce of 9,000, he delivered historic investments in education, recreation, and parks; launched near-universal free community college; and maintained fiscal responsibility, affirmed by the highest (AAA) credit ratings available to local governments. He created the county’s first Office of the Inspector General, implemented public campaign financing, and opened government like never before through innovative budget town halls. In moments of crisis — from the COVID-19 pandemic to the Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse — Johnny O earned widespread praise for leading with steadiness, compassion, and results.
First elected to Congress in 2024, Johnny O hit the ground running. He quickly secured a competitive spot on the influential Democratic Steering and Policy Committee and serves on the House’s Small Business and Foreign Affairs Committees. In Washington, he is focused on affordability, expanding workforce and education pathways, increasing access to housing, and defending American democracy at home and abroad. And he’s earned a reputation as a skilled problem solver for constituents back home in the district.
Johnny O is a proud graduate of Baltimore County public schools and a first-generation college student. He holds a Bachelor’s degree from Goucher College, a Master’s degree from George Washington University, and a Ph.D. in public policy from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County. He lives in eastern Baltimore County with his wife, Marisa, their daughter, Daria, and their rescue dog, Yachty.

pages.title: Johnny O – Democrat for Congress | Johnny’s Priorities
pages.text:
## Strengthening the Middle Class
Johnny O knows that a strong middle class is America’s economic engine — and he’s fighting every day to make sure hardworking families have the tools they need to get ahead, not just get by. He’s pushing for higher wages, affordable healthcare, and strong, fully funded public schools that prepare every child for success.
One of the first bills he passed in the House directly strengthens the workforce pipeline by connecting employers with graduates of career and technical education programs — helping Marylanders secure good-paying jobs and helping local businesses fill critical positions.
Johnny O has been a steadfast defender of workers’ rights and the essential programs middle-class families count on, including SNAP to combat food insecurity, Medicare to keep healthcare affordable for seniors, and Social Security to protect workers’ retirement security.
And when Republicans advanced a budget that handed massive tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy while threatening cuts to the very programs working families depend on, Johnny O forcefully opposed it — standing firmly on the side of middle-class Marylanders.
## Lowering Costs
Johnny O gets it: if you can’t afford your rent or mortgage, groceries or healthcare, little else matters. He’s laser-focused on lowering costs for struggling families and calling out House leadership for its refusal to take up meaningful legislation to do so.
He’s pushing to extend critical health-insurance tax credits, end the reckless Trump-era tariffs that are driving up prices, rein in prescription drug costs, expand the housing supply, and cut utility bills. And he’s fighting to protect essential lifelines like Medicare, Medicaid, SNAP, and the Child Tax Credit—programs that help families stay afloat when times are tough.
Johnny O is fighting to ensure working Americans aren’t just scraping by— they’re finally getting ahead.
## Fighting for Healthcare
Johnny O is pushing to make healthcare more affordable and accessible for American families. He fought to extend Affordable Care Act tax credits that help keep premiums down, while protecting core programs like Medicare and Medicaid from cuts. He’s also working to expand access in underserved communities and safeguard reproductive healthcare.
There’s a lot Congress can do to lower prescription drug costs, especially within Medicare. Johnny O supports more aggressive price negotiations, capping out-of-pocket costs and improving price transparency so patients face fewer surprise bills.
And he’s also vehemently opposed to the Trump Administration’s cuts to programs and agencies that conduct critical medical research and ensure access to life-saving vaccines.
## Defending Democracy
The Trump Administration is engaged in a relentless and direct assault on our democratic principles — from demanding the prosecution of perceived political opponents, to censoring comedians; from deploying our military into American communities, to unilaterally cutting federal funds approved for Congress.
Johnny O is fighting for the soul of our democracy by supporting legislation to expand voting rights, protect the independence of our courts, and prevent presidential abuses. He’s speaking out against the politicization of our military and championing efforts to restore integrity to politics, such as banning stock trading by Members of Congress.
## Expanding Housing Access
Everyone deserves a safe, stable roof over their head. Johnny O knows that quality housing opens the door to opportunity, which is why he worked tirelessly to significantly expand attainable housing across Baltimore County. Now, he’s taking that fight to Washington to tackle the national housing shortage and soaring rent and mortgage costs.
Johnny O introduced first-of-its-kind legislation to create a national housing loss rate—similar to the unemployment rate—so policymakers can finally track, understand, and confront this crisis. He’s also leading efforts to convert vacant and underused buildings into affordable homes, and he supports common-sense steps like tax incentives for first-time homebuyers, expanded access to small-dollar mortgages, and reducing tariffs on construction materials.
## Supporting Students and Improving Education
As a graduate, teacher, and parent in the Baltimore County Public Schools system, Johnny O knows firsthand how a high-quality education can transform lives.
As Baltimore County Executive, he delivered record investments in new school construction and created near-universal free community college for county residents. Now, he’s standing up to extreme efforts to dismantle the Department of Education and gut federal support for special education and schools in low-income communities.
The Trump Administration is pushing policies that ban books, enable discrimination against LGBTQ+ students, and divert taxpayer dollars to private schools. Johnny O is pushing back to ensuring that every student—no matter who they are or where they come from—has the opportunity to reach their full potential.
## Preserving our Environment
Johnny O knows that climate change is real and he is insisting on immediate, bold action to address it. In Congress, he is pushing for aggressive, science-driven policies that will create jobs and help restore our environment.
He strongly rejects the Trump Administration’s efforts to dismantle landmark protections that ensure Americans have clean air and water — and to slash funding for vital environmental programs that safeguard cherished resources like the Chesapeake Bay.
Instead, Johnny O backs strategic, large-scale investments in renewable energy: deploying solar, wind and other clean-energy technologies not only to dramatically cut carbon emissions, but also to create thousands of good-paying, sustainable jobs — boosting communities while protecting the planet.
## Protecting Veterans
Johnny O deeply believes in doing all we can to support those who have put everything on the line for our freedoms. He is fighting to increase funding for the Department of Veterans Affairs, expand medical care for millions of veterans at its hospitals and clinics and protect essential benefits like disability compensation, pensions, and education programs. He also opposed efforts to roll back expanded care for veterans exposed to toxic substances provided under the landmark PACT Act.
Johnny O is also pushing for more resources for veterans mental health counseling, crisis intervention, and substance-use treatment, while also funding housing programs and outreach teams that help veterans find stable housing. He’s joining efforts to improve opportunities for veterans returning to civilian life, signing on to legislation to expand education and job-training programs.
